points.K10: 近视眼镜不能代替防护

points.K12: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套
points.K14: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
points.K15: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、通知
points.K16: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
points.K17: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性
points.K20: 按规定处置化学品和废物
points.K22: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a few reagent bottles and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列第五课：安全操作化学品。
overlay: 实验室安全（五）：化学品的安全操作

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着几瓶试剂，急匆匆走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hurries toward a lab bench carrying several reagent bottles in his arms.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶时间，抱起试剂就想开干。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，递给他一张空白的准备清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and hands him a blank preparation checklist.
shots.narration: 小研说：先准备，再动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜举起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 有句老话：不做准备，就是准备失败。

shots.scene: 空白日历和清单图标，旁边一个打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank calendar and a blank checklist with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验之前，都要做好准备。

shots.scene: 老周在台前操作，小研戴黄色隔热手套从灭菌锅里提出网篮
shots.prompt_en: The older man works at a bench while the female graduate student in yellow heat-resistant gloves lifts a wire basket from an autoclave.
shots.narration: 开始之前，先判断可能的风险。

shots.scene: 阿杰在门口挂钩处穿实验服，旁边是洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a lab coat at the coat hooks by the door, next to an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 穿戴合适的个人防护装备。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标和急救十字图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a first aid cross icon side by side, next to a reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 了解这种化学品的防护和应急方法。

shots.scene: 小研戴面屏在通风柜前，把酸慢慢倒进盛水的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a face shield, slowly pours acid from a bottle into a beaker of water in a fume hood.
shots.narration: 稀释酸碱，要把酸碱加进水里。

shots.scene: 水倒进酸里、烧瓶冒泡的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being poured into an acid flask that foams up, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来倒，可能剧烈反应、造成烧伤。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶被带出实验室门的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a reagent bottle being carried out through the lab door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品绝不能带出实验室。

shots.section_title: 转运用防破碎二次容器
shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶放进带盖的防碎塑料提桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a reagent bottle inside a lidded shatter-proof plastic carrier.
shots.narration: 在实验室之间转运化学品，
overlay: 转运用防破碎二次容器

shots.section_title: 转运用防破碎二次容器
shots.scene: 小研提着二次容器走过走廊
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the secondary container down a hallway to another lab.
shots.narration: 要用防破碎的二次容器。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上皮肤、眼睛、鼻子三处亮起
shots.prompt_en: A human outline with the skin, eyes and nose highlighted by three arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 要避免皮肤、眼睛接触，也要防吸入。

shots.scene: 小研戴带侧护的安全眼镜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the female graduate student wearing safety glasses with side shields.
shots.narration: 带侧护的安全眼镜有一定防护。

shots.scene: 液体飞溅绕过眼镜的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid splashing around safety glasses toward an eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但遇到飞溅危险，它就不够用了。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴化学防溅护目镜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the young male student wearing chemical splash goggles.
shots.narration: 化学防溅护目镜，保护更有效。

shots.scene: 护目镜镜框上的一枚标准标识特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the frame of the splash goggles showing a small engraved standard mark without readable text. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜上要有美国国家标准的标识。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替防护
shots.scene: 普通近视眼镜图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of ordinary prescription glasses crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通近视眼镜，防护是不够的。
overlay: 近视眼镜不能代替防护

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替防护
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前把面屏戴在眼镜外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a full face shield on over her prescription glasses at a fume hood.
shots.narration: 外面再戴安全眼镜、护目镜或全面屏。

shots.section_title: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
shots.scene: 标签上的腐蚀象形图特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a reagent bottle label showing the GHS corrosion pictogram and blank text. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀性化学品溅到皮肤会伤人。
overlay: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙

shots.section_title: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
shots.scene: 小研扣好实验服，戴上手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buttons her lab coat and pulls on gloves.
shots.narration: 实验服和手套，只能保护一部分。

shots.section_title: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
shots.scene: 阿杰系上全长的蓝色耐化学品围裙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ties on a full-length blue chemical-resistant apron.
shots.narration: 有飞溅危险，最好穿全长耐化学品围裙。

shots.section_title: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套
shots.scene: 戴黑色长臂橡胶手套的双手拿着烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Hands in long black arm-length rubber gloves hold a flask. No faces.
shots.narration: 腐蚀性特别强的，戴长臂橡胶手套。
overlay: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套

shots.section_title: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套
shots.scene: 普通丁腈手套图标旁打叉，长臂橡胶手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin nitrile glove with a red X next to a long rubber glove with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不要只戴普通的丁腈手套。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，身旁飘过淡淡的蒸气线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera as faint vapor lines drift past.
shots.narration: 有些化学品，不碰到也能伤人。

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 凑近瓶口闻的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a nose sniffing directly at a bottle mouth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用鼻子闻化学品。
overlay: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内倾倒试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a reagent inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 有毒化学品一律在通风柜里操作。

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 手把试剂瓶盖拧紧
shots.prompt_en: A hand screws the cap tightly onto a reagent bottle. No faces.
shots.narration: 不用的时候，容器盖紧。

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、通知
shots.scene: 地上一只摔碎的棕色瓶子，液体溅开
shots.prompt_en: A broken brown reagent bottle on the lab floor with liquid spreading out. No people.
shots.narration: 发生大量化学品溢洒，
overlay: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、通知

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、通知
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰捂住口鼻后退，跑出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student cover their noses, back away and run out of the lab.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，封闭实验室。

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、通知
shots.scene: 手机拨号，屏幕空白；门上贴上一块空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A mobile phone being dialed with a blank screen, then a blank warning sign taped onto the lab door. No faces.
shots.narration: 通知有关部门。

shots.section_title: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
shots.scene: 大片蒸汽线从溢洒处升起的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of heavy vapor clouds rising from a large spill. No people.
shots.narration: 大量溢洒会产生大量蒸气。
overlay: 专业人员清理，许可后返回

shots.section_title: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
shots.scene: 穿全套防护的老李进入实验室清理
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in full protective gear enters the lab to clean up the spill.
shots.narration: 必须由有资质的专业人员清理。

shots.section_title: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
shots.scene: 老周在门口点头示意可以进入
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the lab door and nods to show it is safe to re-enter.
shots.narration: 主管宣布安全前，不要回实验室。

shots.section_title: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，身旁出现火焰和爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside a flame icon and an explosion icon.
shots.narration: 易燃化学品，需要特殊处理。
overlay: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性

shots.section_title: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜在台前查看试剂标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing goggles, checks a reagent label at the bench.
shots.narration: 先了解每种化学品的易燃易爆性。

shots.scene: 易燃洗瓶靠近加热板和本生灯
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle with a flame pictogram sits next to a hot plate and a Bunsen burner. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃品要远离一切点火源，

shots.scene: 本生灯和加热板图标旁一个远离的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a Bunsen burner and a hot plate with an arrow moving a flammable bottle away from them. No people.
shots.narration: 比如本生灯、加热板。

shots.scene: 阿杰打开黄色易燃品储存柜，柜子连着接地线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a yellow flammable storage cabinet that has a grounding wire attached.
shots.narration: 易燃品放在专用的接地储存柜里。

shots.section_title: 按规定处置化学品和废物
shots.scene: 小研从通风柜下取出废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a waste container out from under a fume hood.
shots.narration: 实验结束，要妥善处置化学品和废物。
overlay: 按规定处置化学品和废物

shots.section_title: 按规定处置化学品和废物
shots.scene: 国家、地方、单位三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a national emblem shape, a city building and a lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 按国家、地方和本单位的要求。

shots.scene: 漏斗插在贴着空白危险废物标签的废液桶上
shots.prompt_en: A funnel sits in a waste container with a blank hazardous waste label. No people.
shots.narration: 用耐化学品的塑料或金属容器收集。

shots.section_title: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂
shots.scene: 通风柜里敞口的烧杯和试剂瓶被打上红叉
shots.prompt_en: Open beakers and bottles left in a fume hood to evaporate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能在通风柜里蒸发溶剂来处置。
overlay: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂

shots.section_title: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教，旁边是一套蒸发装置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man for advice next to an evaporation apparatus in a fume hood.
shots.narration: 需要蒸发溶剂，先请教实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物
shots.scene: 小研戴面屏在通风柜内用纸巾擦拭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a face shield, wipes up a small spill inside the fume hood with paper towels.
shots.narration: 清理溢洒用过的纸巾等材料，
overlay: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物

shots.section_title: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物
shots.scene: 用过的纸巾装进塑料袋
shots.prompt_en: Used paper towels are sealed inside a plastic bag. No people.
shots.narration: 也是危险废物，要按要求处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，身旁浮现瓶子、手和急救十字三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside three icons: a bottle, a hand and a first aid cross.
shots.narration: 知道用的是什么、怎么操作、出事怎么办。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一张带右箭头的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank card with a right arrow on it.
shots.narration: 准备是关键。下一课讲其他常见危害。

shots.scene: 清单、酸入水、二次容器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a checklist, acid pouring into water and a secondary container. No people.
shots.narration: 先准备，酸入水，转运用二次容器。

shots.scene: 护目镜、围裙、长臂手套、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of splash goggles, an apron, long rubber gloves and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、围裙、长臂手套、通风柜。

shots.scene: 撤离、易燃品柜、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit arrow, a yellow flammable cabinet and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 大量溢洒就撤离，易燃品进柜。

shots.scene: 废液桶和纸巾袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a waste container and a bag of used paper towels. No people.
shots.narration: 废物按规定处置，不靠蒸发。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 做好准备再动手，下次见！
